independent_circuit.method: Independent pure NumPy statevector: explicit half-angle RY, sequential big-endian CNOT permutations, ascending wire Z from probabilities, unpadded moments, right zero padding and saved affine readout. Current production CO FG/FE/MB-1 only; no PennyLane or Torch imported; no pair/triple gates in this production branch. Compared to saved predictions; training audit separately reproduces those predictions with current executable model. This triangulates forward results, not arbitrary gates or training gradients.
